deck: The Dolomites are spread out, and the best days here take planning. These are the ones I set up for clients.

doors.p: A helicopter up to the high ground and a guided hike back down. If the budget allows, it’s the most memorable day you can have here.
They know the quiet trails and when to go. I’d always choose one over going with the crowds, and the good ones book up in summer, so I arrange them ahead.
The postcard ridgeline above Val Gardena. The lift runs on timed tickets that sell out, so I lock in your time before you arrive.
Rolling meadows under the Sassolungo and the Sciliar, by gondola from Ortisei. A completely different landscape from Seceda, and easy walking for all levels.

doors.h: The Sellaronda with a ski guide
doors.p: A full-day loop around the Sella massif, through four valleys. A private guide knows the connections, and the best huts for lunch.
The hotels cost far less than the big-name Alps resorts, and it’s not a scene. December and March are the sweet spots, and I’ll find you the hotel offers worth booking.
Fly into Venice, split the trip between two hotels, and never think about the roads. I handle every transfer.
